what_to_detect: The monarch's inherent end-step trigger, which has no printed line: a trigger record of the engine-defined monarch draw trigger that fired at the beginning of the monarch's end step.
near_miss: The same engine trigger evaluated at the beginning of the end step of a player who is not the monarch, not firing.
record_fields: trigger record with empty ability and ability_unresolved engine_effect

what_to_detect: The monarch's inherent combat-damage trigger, which has no printed line: a trigger record of the engine-defined trigger that fired when a creature dealt combat damage to the monarch.
near_miss: The same engine trigger evaluated against combat damage dealt to a player who is not the monarch, or to a creature, not firing.
record_fields: trigger record with empty ability and ability_unresolved engine_effect

what_to_detect: A static ability whose control-changing effect is keyed to the monarch applies while no player is the monarch and changes no permanent's controller.
near_miss: The same kind of static applying while a player is the monarch, the affected permanent controlled by the monarch.
record_fields: gen-3 card lines active on statics
continuous contributions carry no control channel, so continuous_contribution cannot read it
